reason: Fixations are relatively long (mostly 200–500 ms) and densely clustered around the screen center with short, small-amplitude saccades and no clear large, goal-directed sweeps or rapid wide-range scanning. This pattern is characteristic of reading continuous text rather than visually exploring pages (BROWSE/SEARCH), tracking dynamic game or video content (PLAY/WATCH), or alternating between text and keyboard/own text production (WRITE).
